correctness.rationale: Fixing T=S intersection maximal elements B is determined by their lower/upper statuses; for each minimal a, membership bit s gives two distinct statuses iff all members of N(a) have identical T status, including empty neighborhood; such bits vary independently. This yields the exact height-two formula. For graph incidence a minimal edge has exactly its two endpoints and contributes factor two iff monochromatic. Expanding 2^[equal colours] =1+[equal] over edges gives sum_{F subset E}2^{# components}; Tutte subset expansion at (3,2) proves equality. Deletion/contraction and trees/cycles/complete graphs are exact consequences. #P membership is a nondeterministic witness (vertex colouring, chosen monochromatic edges) and hardness/planar tractability are explicitly cited prior theorems, not inferred from computation. Independent enumeration directly deduplicated all lower/upper pairs and compared spin and FK expressions for each of the 75 simple graphs on 1..4 vertices; all agreed. Infinite graph statement rests on the symbolic local/FK proof.
